_: Every repository Quavern publishes, and the openings it prepares. `state` is public (the repository exists and is public), preparing (a written specification, no public code yet) or studying (a study is under way; nothing is decided). `list: false` keeps an entry out of the site. With --check-github the build fails when a public repository of the Quavern organisation is missing here, or when a `public` entry has no public repository.

en.name: Quavsit Observatory
en.summary: A dated daily record of what 147 French public-transport feeds are worth when an engine reads them: timetable end dates, feed age, and how much real-time data matches the timetable. Specification written; no public code yet.
